p1_findings.title: binary source numeric and identity contract is not frozen
p1_findings.impact: The analyzer cannot construct one exact Acc24 reference or context packing without choosing whether source is implicit plus one, what sign means, and whether source coordinates and event identity are retained or reconstructed.
p1_findings.required_fix: Freeze binary source value and sign semantics, exact source-coordinate reconstruction or storage, event/frontier identity, and field-level packing for every 128-bit ingress and 256-bit context entry.

p1_findings.title: backing existence and mandatory state are not a closed ledger
p1_findings.impact: After resident-tag replacement, an uncharged implementation may choose six-cycle zero-fill rather than forty-one-cycle restore; resident-weight identity, refill/shared-link control, pending RMW, global frontier/fault ownership and backing state can also become hidden candidate-only state.
p1_findings.required_fix: Use a charged full backing initialization, a charged persistent backing-valid/address directory, or a precise statically provable first-contributor rule shared by all four points; list exact bits, owners and ports for every mandatory memory and control state.

p2_findings.finding: The future CPU contract should emit group, RMW and commit sequence hashes so equivalence to A1-OSG is mechanically killable rather than decided from totals.
A passing S10 local gate remains a single-sequence local result; robustness and system claims require same-cohort and multi-sequence evidence.

required_r3_closure: freeze decoder binary source value and sign semantics
freeze source coordinate and event frontier identity plus field-level ingress and context packing
freeze one executable external-backing existence and restore rule shared by all four points
close the mandatory memory and standard-cell state ledger without hidden use of headroom
retain atomic ingress four-context-per-phase transition and fixed strongest A1 baseline
retain candidate B exact-zero and M519 prerequisite
